1. Relationship with our Terms and Conditions

This Disclaimer provides additional information about the nature and limitations of our content and Services. It should be read together with our Terms and Conditions, Privacy Policy, and Cookie Policy.

If this Disclaimer conflicts with an expressly agreed contract, proposal, order confirmation, or mandatory law, the applicable agreement or mandatory law will take precedence.

2. General educational information

Content made available through the Services is generally provided for educational, informational, language-learning, communication, personal-development, expatriate-support, and business-training purposes.

General website content, articles, examples, templates, downloads, exercises, and training materials are not prepared specifically for your individual circumstances unless we have expressly agreed to provide a personalised service.

You should use your own judgement when applying general information and consider whether it is suitable for your circumstances, objectives, level of experience, and organisation.

3. No regulated professional advice

Unless expressly agreed otherwise in writing, our general content does not constitute:

  • legal advice;
  • tax or accounting advice;
  • financial or investment advice;
  • immigration or visa advice;
  • medical or psychological advice;
  • employment-law or human-resources advice;
  • regulated career or professional advice; or
  • another service that may lawfully be provided only by a licensed or regulated professional.

References to laws, immigration procedures, employment practices, business matters, or other specialist subjects are provided only as general educational information. Such information may not reflect the latest rule, official interpretation, or your individual circumstances.

You should consult an appropriately qualified professional or the relevant official authority before making a decision that requires regulated or specialist advice.

4. Training, coaching, and learning outcomes

Courses, lessons, coaching, exercises, assignments, and training materials are designed to support learning and development. Individual outcomes depend on factors outside our control, including:

  • your starting level and prior experience;
  • attendance, participation, and effort;
  • the time available for study or practice;
  • the accuracy and completeness of information you provide;
  • your personal or organisational circumstances; and
  • decisions made by employers, schools, authorities, or other third parties.

Unless expressly guaranteed in a written agreement, we do not guarantee that use of the Services will result in:

  • a particular language level;
  • a particular examination score;
  • successful completion of a course or assessment;
  • employment, promotion, admission, or placement;
  • a visa, residence permit, or immigration outcome;
  • a professional qualification or regulated certification;
  • increased income, sales, or business performance; or
  • any other particular personal, educational, or commercial result.

5. Examinations, assessments, and results

Examinations, quizzes, level tests, assignments, and other assessments are intended to measure knowledge, skills, progress, or performance within the scope described for the relevant assessment.

Unless expressly stated otherwise in writing, assessment results are intended for educational, coaching, placement, evaluation, or internal training purposes. They are not:

  • a government-issued diploma;
  • a formally accredited qualification;
  • a regulated professional licence;
  • an immigration or visa document;
  • an employment guarantee; or
  • proof that a person is suitable for every role or situation.

Some results may be calculated automatically using predefined scoring rules. Automatically generated or provisional results may be reviewed and corrected if we identify:

  • an incorrect answer key;
  • a scoring or configuration error;
  • a technical malfunction;
  • incomplete or corrupted assessment data;
  • a breach of assessment rules; or
  • another material irregularity.

An assessment reflects performance under the conditions and at the time it was completed. It may not represent future performance or performance in a different context.

6. Use of results by organisations

Employers, schools, training providers, and other organisations may use the Services for internal training, development, placement, or evaluation.

Such organisations remain responsible for:

  • deciding whether a particular assessment is suitable for their intended purpose;
  • interpreting results fairly and in their proper context;
  • considering other relevant information before making significant decisions;
  • complying with employment, equality, education, privacy, and other applicable laws;
  • avoiding unlawful discrimination or inappropriate automated decision-making; and
  • providing any notices, review procedures, or human oversight required by law.

Unless we have expressly agreed to perform a separate professional evaluation, an organisation should not rely exclusively on one assessment result when making a decision that may significantly affect an individual.

7. Accuracy and completeness

We take reasonable care when preparing and maintaining our content. However, general content may:

  • contain an error or omission;
  • become outdated;
  • require additional explanation or context;
  • differ from an official source or current professional practice; or
  • not apply to every person, country, organisation, or situation.

We may correct, supplement, update, or remove content when reasonably necessary. The existence of an error does not automatically mean that every related product, assessment, or Service is invalid.

Where you believe that content or an assessment result contains a material error, please contact us and provide sufficient information for us to investigate it.

8. Information supplied by users

Some Services depend on information that you, your employer, your school, or another organisation provides to us.

We may be unable to provide an accurate, complete, or suitable service where supplied information is:

  • incorrect;
  • incomplete;
  • outdated;
  • misleading;
  • submitted without proper authority; or
  • not provided within an applicable deadline.

You are responsible for checking information you submit and for informing us of relevant corrections.

9. Availability and technical limitations

We aim to keep the Services reasonably available and functional, but uninterrupted or error-free access cannot be guaranteed.

Availability may be affected by:

  • scheduled or emergency maintenance;
  • internet or telecommunications failures;
  • hosting, cloud, payment, email, or storage-provider disruptions;
  • browser, device, software, or compatibility problems;
  • security incidents or protective measures;
  • power outages or events outside our reasonable control; and
  • errors in information or files supplied by a user.

You are responsible for maintaining a suitable device, supported browser, internet connection, email account, and any other technical requirements communicated for the relevant Service.

If a significant technical problem prevents you from receiving a paid Service, your rights and available remedies will be determined by the applicable agreement, our Terms and Conditions, and mandatory law.

10. Downloads and digital materials

You are responsible for checking whether downloadable files and digital materials are suitable for your intended use and compatible with your device or software.

Although we take reasonable security precautions, you should maintain appropriate security software, backups, and device protections when downloading or using electronic files.

Templates, examples, and sample documents normally require review and adaptation before they are used in a real business, legal, educational, employment, or personal situation. Their availability does not mean that they are complete or suitable for every purpose.

11. External links

The Services may contain links to websites, platforms, documents, or resources operated by independent third parties.

An external link is normally provided for convenience or additional information. Unless expressly stated otherwise, a link does not mean that we:

  • control the external service;
  • approve or endorse all of its content;
  • guarantee its accuracy, security, or availability;
  • accept responsibility for its products or services; or
  • have a commercial relationship with its operator.

Independent third-party websites are governed by their own terms, privacy notices, cookie policies, and security practices.

12. Providers used to deliver the Services

We may rely on providers for hosting, content delivery, cloud storage, email, payments, security, and other operational functions.

These service providers are different from unrelated external websites that you choose to visit through a link. The fact that a provider performs part of a Service does not automatically remove responsibilities that applicable law or our agreement places on us.

Provider outages or failures may nevertheless affect availability or delivery. Where this affects a paid Service, the applicable remedy will be determined under our Terms and Conditions and mandatory law.

13. Testimonials, reviews, and case studies

Testimonials, reviews, case studies, examples, and sample outcomes may reflect an individual's or organisation's particular experience. Results vary, and such material does not promise that another user will achieve the same result.

Where a scenario is fictional, simplified, anonymised, or compiled from multiple situations, it may be presented solely to illustrate a concept.

We aim not to publish testimonials or endorsements in a misleading manner. Any material commercial relationship or incentive will be disclosed where required by law.

Permitted use of courses, downloads, examinations, templates, and other materials is governed by our Terms and Conditions and any applicable written licence.

Liability relating to the purchase or use of the Services is governed primarily by our Terms and Conditions, the applicable agreement, and mandatory law.
